name: v0.1.0-beta.1
description:
Rev Panther v0.1.0-beta.1 (Official First Beta Release)

• In-App Updates: Smooth, paced 0–100% download progress with M3 Expressive wavy progress indicators
• Resilient Updates: Edge-cached distribution with instant fallback mirror (no GitLab 429 rate limit blocks)
• Strict Channels: Separate Stable and Beta (Rolling) release streams with zero cross-channel leaks
• Developer Profile: Redesigned with layered Material 3 Expressive pill capsules, bouncy spring physics, and gentle ambient breathing
• Glass Dock & Navigation: Edge-to-edge alignment and customizable dock styling
• Connectivity: TVS SmartXonnect Bluetooth reconnect reliability improvements
